items.heading: Getting to Dialysis
steps: Call Lakeshore Community Health Plan using the number on your plan card to schedule rides.

items.heading: Getting Kidney-Friendly Food
steps: Go to Manna Food Pantry on Mondays 1:00-3:00 PM at 1230 S Millard Ave.
Ask the DaVita Park Manor dietitian to adapt your renal diet around corner store foods you can get.
Go to Greater Garfield MB Church pantry on Fridays 10:00 AM-12:00 PM at 3757 W Douglas Blvd.

items.heading: Daily Weight and Blood Pressure
steps: Keep writing down your weight and blood pressure each day and bring the log to each session.

closing: Tell your care team if you have trouble following this plan.
